# 🚀 Syno AI - Synthetic Data Generation & LLM Fine-Tuning Platform > **Production-grade AI platform for synthetic data generation, intelligent chat interface, and one-click LLM fine-tuning with LoRA adapters.** [![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-3.12+-blue.svg)](https://www.python.org/) [![FastAPI](https://img.shields.io/badge/FastAPI-0.109+-green.svg)](https://fastapi.tiangolo.com/) [![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-18.3+-61DAFB.svg)](https://reactjs.org/) [![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-5.6+-3178C6.svg)](https://www.typescriptlang.org/) [![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg)](LICENSE) --- ## 📋 Table of Contents - [Overview](#-overview) - [Features](#-features) - [Architecture](#-architecture) - [Tech Stack](#-tech-stack) - [Prerequisites](#-prerequisites) - [Quick Start](#-quick-start) - [Installation](#-installation) - [Configuration](#-configuration) - [Usage Guide](#-usage-guide) - [API Documentation](#-api-documentation) - [Fine-Tuning Module](#-fine-tuning-module) - [Deployment](#-deployment) - [Development](#-development) - [Project Structure](#-project-structure) - [Contributing](#-contributing) - [License](#-license) --- ## 🎯 Overview **Syno AI** is a comprehensive AI platform that combines three powerful capabilities: 1. **🤖 Intelligent Chat Interface** - Upload datasets and interact with AI using natural language commands for data processing, synthetic data generation, and analytics 2. **📊 Synthetic Data Generation** - Generate realistic synthetic datasets using advanced ML models (CTGAN, TVAE, Copulas) 3. **🎓 One-Click LLM Fine-Tuning** - Fine-tune small language models (66MB-548MB) with pre-curated datasets in under 5 minutes using LoRA adapters on CPU Built for data scientists, developers, and AI enthusiasts who need a complete toolkit for data manipulation and model training without complex infrastructure. --- ## ✨ Features ### 💬 Intelligent Chat System - **Natural Language Commands** - Process data using plain English ("clean this dataset", "remove nulls", "generate 1000 rows") - **Intent Recognition** - AI-powered intent parsing using Groq/Llama models - **Real-time Operations** - Execute data cleaning, augmentation, formatting, and generation through chat - **Operation History** - Track all data transformations with before/after statistics - **Session Management** - Multiple concurrent sessions with persistent history ### 📊 Data Management - **Multi-format Support** - Upload CSV, Excel (XLSX), Parquet files - **Interactive Data Preview** - Excel-style table view with sorting, filtering, and search - **Data Profiling** - Automatic statistics, distributions, and quality metrics - **Visual Analytics** - Auto-generated charts (histograms, correlations, pie charts) - **Export Options** - Download processed data in multiple formats ### 🎓 LLM Fine-Tuning Module - **6 Pre-configured Models** - DistilGPT-2 (85MB), DistilBERT (66MB), GPT-2 (548MB), BERT Base (440MB), Phi-2 (280MB), MobileBERT (100MB) - **6 Real Datasets from HuggingFace** - MBPP (code), GSM8K (math), ROCStories (creative writing), DailyDialog (conversation), IMDB (sentiment), SciQ (science) - **One-Click Download** - Click to download models and datasets from HuggingFace with caching - **Split-Aware Preview** - View train/test/validation splits in Excel-style table format - **LoRA Fine-Tuning** - Low-Rank Adaptation for efficient CPU training (~3 minutes) - **Real-time Progress** - Live training metrics, loss tracking, and ETA - **Model Playground** - Test fine-tuned models with chat interface before downloading - **Dual Download** - Export as merged model (~100MB) or LoRA adapters only (~10MB) - **Transparent Configuration** - View all hyperparameters and training code ### 🛠️ Data Operations - **Clean Data** - Remove nulls, duplicates, and outliers - **Augment Data** - SMOTE, random oversampling, data synthesis - **Format Data** - Column transformations, type conversions - **Generate Synthetic Data** - CTGAN, TVAE, Copulas models - **Row/Column Operations** - Add, update, delete rows and columns - **Anonymization** - Remove sensitive data while preserving structure ### 🎨 User Experience - **Modern UI** - Dark theme with responsive design - **Real-time Updates** - Live progress tracking and notifications - **Keyboard Shortcuts** - `Ctrl+K` (focus chat), `Ctrl+U` (upload), `Ctrl+B` (toggle panel) - **Mobile Responsive** - Works on tablets and smaller screens - **Compact Design** - Information-dense interface matching professional tools --- ## 🏗️ Architecture ``` ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │ Frontend (React) │ │ ┌─────────────┐ ┌──────────────┐ ┌──────────────────┐ │ │ │ Chat UI │ │ Data Preview │ │ Fine-Tuning UI │ │ │ └─────────────┘ └──────────────┘ └──────────────────┘ │ └───────────────────────────┬─────────────────────────────────┘ │ HTTP/WebSocket ┌───────────────────────────▼─────────────────────────────────┐ │ Backend (FastAPI) │ │ ┌────────────┐ ┌──────────────┐ ┌──────────────────┐ │ │ │ Chat Engine│ │ Data Manager │ │ Fine-Tuning API │ │ │ └────────────┘ └──────────────┘ └──────────────────┘ │ └────────┬──────────────┬─────────────────┬──────────────────┘ │ │ │ ┌────▼────┐ ┌────▼────┐ ┌──────▼──────┐ │ Groq AI │ │ Storage │ │ HuggingFace │ │ (LLM) │ │ (Files) │ │ (Datasets) │ └─────────┘ └─────────┘ └─────────────┘ ``` --- ## 🛠️ Tech Stack ### Backend - **FastAPI** - High-performance async web framework - **PyTorch** - Deep learning framework for model training - **Transformers** - HuggingFace model loading and training - **PEFT** - Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (LoRA) - **SDV** - Synthetic Data Vault for data generation - **Pandas/Polars** - Data manipulation and analysis - **SQLAlchemy** - Async database ORM - **Groq API** - Fast LLM inference for chat ### Frontend - **React 18** - Component-based UI library - **TypeScript** - Type-safe JavaScript - **Tailwind CSS** - Utility-first CSS framework - **React Query** - Server state management - **Zustand** - Lightweight state management - **Axios** - HTTP client - **Lucide React** - Beautiful icon library - **Recharts** - Data visualization ### Infrastructure - **SQLite** - Local database (development) - **PostgreSQL** - Production database - **Vite** - Fast frontend build tool - **Docker** - Containerization support --- ## 📋 Prerequisites - **Python 3.12+** - **Node.js 18+** - **Git** - **4GB+ RAM** (8GB recommended for fine-tuning) - **Groq API Key** (free at https://console.groq.com) --- ## 🚀 Quick Start ### 1️⃣ Clone Repository ```bash git clone https://github.com/your-username/syno-ai.git cd syno-ai ``` ### 2️⃣ Setup Backend ```bash # Create virtual environment python -m venv .venv .venv\Scripts\activate # Windows source .venv/bin/activate # Mac/Linux # Install dependencies pip install -r requirements.txt # Create .env file cp .env.example .env # Add your Groq API key to .env echo "GROQ_API_KEY=your_key_here" >> .env # Start backend python -m app.main ``` ### 3️⃣ Setup Frontend ```bash # Open new terminal cd frontend # Install dependencies npm install # Create .env file cp .env.example .env.local # Start frontend npm run dev ``` ### 4️⃣ Access Application - **Frontend**: http://localhost:3000 - **Backend API**: http://localhost:8000 - **API Docs**: http://localhost:8000/docs --- ## 📦 Installation ### Option 1: Using Start Scripts (Windows) ```bash # Run the startup script (starts both backend and frontend) .\start.bat ``` ### Option 2: Using Start Scripts (Linux/Mac) ```bash chmod +x start.sh ./start.sh ``` ### Option 3: Using Docker ```bash docker-compose up -d ``` ### Option 4: Manual Setup #### Backend Setup ```bash # Create and activate virtual environment python -m venv .venv .venv\Scripts\activate # Windows source .venv/bin/activate # Mac/Linux # Install all dependencies pip install -r requirements.txt # Setup environment variables cp .env.example .env # Edit .env and add your GROQ_API_KEY # Initialize database (automatic on first run) python -m app.main ``` #### Frontend Setup ```bash cd frontend # Install dependencies npm install # Setup environment cp .env.example .env.local # Start development server npm run dev ``` --- ## ⚙️ Configuration ### Backend Environment Variables (`.env`) ```env # Groq AI Configuration GROQ_API_KEY=your_api_key_here GROQ_MODEL=llama-3.1-8b-instant # Database DATABASE_URL=sqlite+aiosqlite:///./syno_ai.db # Server HOST=0.0.0.0 PORT=8000 DEBUG=True LOG_LEVEL=INFO # Storage STORAGE_PATH=./storage MAX_UPLOAD_SIZE_MB=100 ``` ### Frontend Environment Variables (`.env.local`) ```env # Backend API URL VITE_API_URL=http://localhost:8000/api/v1 # For remote access (ngrok/Cloudflare) # VITE_API_URL=https://your-ngrok-url.ngrok-free.app/api/v1 ``` --- ## 📖 Usage Guide ### 💬 Chat Workflow 1. **Start Session** - Click "New Chat" or upload a file 2. **Upload Dataset** - Drag & drop CSV, Excel, or Parquet file 3. **Natural Commands** - Type what you want: - *"Clean this dataset"* - *"Remove null values"* - *"Generate 1000 synthetic rows"* - *"Show me summary statistics"* - *"Save as parquet"* 4. **View Results** - See transformed data in preview panel 5. **Export** - Download processed data ### 🎓 Fine-Tuning Workflow 1. **Navigate to Fine-Tune** - Click "Fine-Tune" in sidebar 2. **Select Model** - Click to download (6 options, 66MB-548MB) 3. **Choose Dataset** - Click to download from HuggingFace (6 datasets) 4. **Preview Data** - View samples in Excel-style table with split tabs 5. **Review Config** - Check hyperparameters and training code 6. **Start Training** - Watch real-time progress (~3 minutes) 7. **Test Model** - Chat with your fine-tuned model in playground 8. **Download** - Export as merged model or LoRA adapters ### 📊 Data Operations #### Available Commands | Command | Description | Example | |---------|-------------|---------| | **Clean Data** | Remove nulls, duplicates | "Clean this dataset" | | **Generate Synthetic** | Create synthetic data | "Generate 5000 rows" | | **Augment Data** | Balance classes | "Augment the data" | | **Format Data** | Transform columns | "Format the dataset" | | **Show Stats** | View statistics | "Show me statistics" | | **Export** | Save file | "Save as CSV" | | **Drop Column** | Remove column | "Drop the email column" | | **Add Column** | Create column | "Add a timestamp column" | --- ## 📡 API Documentation ### Interactive Docs - **Swagger UI**: http://localhost:8000/docs - **ReDoc**: http://localhost:8000/redoc ### Key Endpoints #### Chat & Sessions ```http POST /api/v1/session/create # Create new session POST /api/v1/chat # Send chat command GET /api/v1/sessions # List all sessions DELETE /api/v1/sessions/{id} # Delete session ``` #### Data Management ```http POST /api/v1/upload?session_id={id} # Upload files GET /api/v1/datasets # List datasets GET /api/v1/datasets/all # Get all data DELETE /api/v1/datasets/{id} # Delete dataset ``` #### Fine-Tuning ```http GET /api/v1/finetune/models # List available models POST /api/v1/finetune/models/{id}/download # Download model GET /api/v1/finetune/models/{id}/datasets # Get compatible datasets POST /api/v1/finetune/datasets/{id}/download # Download dataset GET /api/v1/finetune/datasets/{id}/preview?split=train # Preview data POST /api/v1/finetune/train # Start fine-tuning GET /api/v1/finetune/jobs/{id} # Get training progress POST /api/v1/finetune/chat/{job_id} # Chat with fine-tuned model GET /api/v1/finetune/models/completed # List completed models DELETE /api/v1/finetune/models/{job_id} # Delete fine-tuned model GET /api/v1/finetune/download/{job_id} # Download fine-tuned model ``` --- ## 🎓 Fine-Tuning Module ### Available Models | Model | Size | Type | Best For | Training Time | |-------|------|------|----------|---------------| | **DistilGPT-2** | 85 MB | Text Generation | Creative writing, code, dialogue | ~3 min | | **DistilBERT** | 66 MB | Classification | Sentiment, spam, intent detection | ~2 min | | **GPT-2 Small** | 548 MB | Text Generation | Higher quality text generation | ~4 min | | **BERT Base** | 440 MB | Classification | Complex classification tasks | ~4 min | | **Phi-2** | 280 MB | Text Generation | Reasoning, math, code | ~5 min | | **MobileBERT** | 100 MB | Classification | Edge device deployment | ~2 min | ### Available Datasets | Dataset | Samples | Size | Type | Compatible Models | |---------|---------|------|------|-------------------| | **MBPP** | 974 | 5 MB | Code Generation | GPT-2 family, Phi-2 | | **GSM8K** | 8,792 | 3 MB | Math Reasoning | GPT-2 family, Phi-2 | | **ROCStories** | 50,000 | 5 MB | Creative Writing | GPT-2 family, Phi-2 | | **DailyDialog** | 13,000 | 15 MB | Conversation | GPT-2 family, Phi-2 | | **IMDB Reviews** | 5,000 | 40 MB | Sentiment | BERT family, MobileBERT | | **SciQ** | 13,000 | 3 MB | Science QA | GPT-2 family, Phi-2 | ### Training Configuration All hyperparameters are fixed for optimal CPU training: ```python { "learning_rate": 2e-5, "num_train_epochs": 3, "per_device_train_batch_size": 4, # 8 for classification "gradient_accumulation_steps": 4, "lora_r": 16, "lora_alpha": 32, "lora_dropout": 0.05, "max_length": 128, "warmup_ratio": 0.1, "weight_decay": 0.01 } ``` ### Storage Structure ``` storage/finetuned_models/ ├── cache/ │ ├── distilgpt2/ # Downloaded base models │ └── datasets/ │ ├── mbpp_train.json │ ├── mbpp_test.json │ └── gsm8k_train.json └── job_abc123/ # Fine-tuned model ├── adapter_model.safetensors ├── adapter_config.json ├── training_metadata.json └── merged/ # Merged model (optional) ├── model.safetensors └── tokenizer.json ``` --- ## 🚀 Deployment ### Production Checklist - [ ] Set `DEBUG=False` in `.env` - [ ] Use PostgreSQL instead of SQLite - [ ] Configure proper CORS origins - [ ] Set up SSL/TLS certificates - [ ] Use Gunicorn instead of Uvicorn for production - [ ] Enable rate limiting - [ ] Set up monitoring and logging - [ ] Configure backup strategy ### Docker Deployment ```bash # Build and run with Docker Compose docker-compose up -d # View logs docker-compose logs -f # Stop services docker-compose down ``` ### Cloud Deployment #### Render.com ```yaml # render.yaml services: - type: web name: syno-ai-backend env: python buildCommand: pip install -r requirements.txt startCommand: uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port $PORT ``` #### Railway.app 1. Connect GitHub repository 2. Set environment variables 3. Deploy automatically --- ## 💻 Development ### Running Tests ```bash # Run all tests pytest # Run with coverage pytest --cov=app --cov-report=html # Run specific test file pytest tests/test_chat.py -v ``` ### Code Quality ```bash # Linting flake8 app/ # Type checking mypy app/ # Format code black app/ isort app/ ``` ### Development Workflow ```bash # Backend (auto-reload enabled) python -m app.main # Frontend (hot module replacement) cd frontend npm run dev # Build for production cd frontend npm run build ``` --- ## 📁 Project Structure ``` syno-ai/ ├── app/ # Backend application │ ├── api/ # API routes │ │ ├── routes.py # Main routes (chat, sessions, data) │ │ └── finetuning_routes.py # Fine-tuning endpoints │ ├── engine/ # Core processing engine │ ├── finetuning/ # Fine-tuning module │ │ ├── datasets/ # Dataset files │ │ ├── datasets_registry.py # Dataset metadata │ │ ├── models_registry.py # Model metadata │ │ ├── trainer.py # Training logic │ │ └── progress_tracker.py # Progress tracking │ ├── generation/ # Synthetic data generation │ ├── models/ # Database models │ ├── nlp/ # Natural language processing │ ├── profiling/ # Data profiling │ └── utils/ # Utilities ├── frontend/ # React frontend │ ├── src/ │ │ ├── api/ # API clients │ │ ├── components/ # React components │ │ │ ├── chat/ # Chat components │ │ │ ├── data/ # Data preview components │ │ │ └── finetuning/ # Fine-tuning components │ │ ├── pages/ # Page components │ │ ├── stores/ # State management │ │ └── hooks/ # Custom hooks │ └── public/ # Static assets ├── storage/ # Data storage │ └── finetuned_models/ # Fine-tuned models ├── tests/ # Test suite ├── requirements.txt # Python dependencies ├── package.json # Node dependencies └── docker-compose.yml # Docker configuration ``` --- ## 🤝 Contributing We welcome contributions! Please follow these steps: 1. **Fork the Repository** ```bash git clone https://github.com/your-username/syno-ai.git cd syno-ai ``` 2. **Create Feature Branch** ```bash git checkout -b feature/amazing-feature ``` 3. **Make Changes** - Write clean, documented code - Add tests for new features - Update documentation 4. **Commit & Push** ```bash git commit -m "Add amazing feature" git push origin feature/amazing-feature ``` 5. **Open Pull Request** ### Contribution Guidelines - Follow existing code style - Write tests for new features - Update documentation - Use descriptive commit messages - Keep PRs focused and manageable --- ## 📝 License This project is licensed under the MIT License - see the [LICENSE](LICENSE) file for details. --- ## 🙏 Acknowledgments - **[HuggingFace](https://huggingface.co/)** - Models and datasets - **[Groq](https://groq.com/)** - Fast LLM inference - **[SDV](https://sdv.dev/)** - Synthetic data generation - **[FastAPI](https://fastapi.tiangolo.com/)** - Backend framework - **[React](https://reactjs.org/)** - Frontend framework --- ## 📞 Support - **Documentation**: [Wiki](https://github.com/your-username/syno-ai/wiki) - **Issues**: [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/your-username/syno-ai/issues) - **Discussions**: [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/your-username/syno-ai/discussions) ---
